title: Data expertise proven in public and education
lead: With experience collecting and analyzing learning data at the national level, we have worked with public agencies and educational institutions on data-driven innovation.

cards.title:
AI Digital Textbook
learning data hub
cards.text: We built a hub that collects AI Digital Textbook learning data using global standards, supporting national-level learning analytics indicators, curriculum standards, and learning maps.

cards.title:
AI-based elementary math
class support system
cards.text: We collected learning behavior data in a gamified class support system and applied level diagnosis and item recommendation models. It is a nationwide public service with 2.4 million cumulative users.

cards.title:
HRD platform
social learning as data
cards.text: We captured social learning experiences from the HRD platform’s social communities and large-scale live webinars as structured learning data.

cards.title:
Seoul Education Platform
video mentoring analysis
cards.text: From video mentoring on the Seoul Education Platform, we collect interactions between mentors and mentees, along with emotional states and utterances, as learning data to support in-depth learning analytics.

logos.alt: Key reference institutions: Ministry of Education, Korea Education and Research Information Service (KERIS), Ministry of Personnel Management, Seoul Metropolitan Government, Gyeonggi Provincial Office of Education, Gangwon Office of Education
